'''Busted Blaster''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer's]] bar on [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]], located in [[Ven Karya Spaceport]] on the edge of the [[Trostlos Waste]].

==History==
In [[137 ABY]], [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Jariah Syn]] confronted the [[Uggli Brothers]] Gang in the bar and became entangled in a brawl. Responding to break up the fight, [[Kiffu Guardians]] stormed the bar. Caught up in the fight, Cade failed to realize that one of the Kiffu Guardians was his cousin, [[Ahnah Rawk|Ahnah]], even turning his pistol onto her before Jariah stepped in between them.
